Realization

Certain gear that has been enhanced to its maximum can be made even stronger through realization.
The Realization button in the gear's details will display further information about how realization will affect the gear.


Gear that can be realized is as follows:

Unique 5★ EX weapons (three limit breaks, max level)

Unique BT weapons for which realization has been unlocked (max level)

Second 5★ HG armor (three limit breaks, max level)

7★ HG armor for which realization has been unlocked (max level)

*BT weapons and 7★ armor are available only for certain characters and added over time.
(BT weapons will not be made available for every character.)
　
*Additional gear may become eligible for realization in future updates.
Gear eligible for realization will have a Realization button added to the gear's details.



The materials needed for realization will differ depending on the gear.
Realization materials can be obtained by refining fragments.

Gear Type Realization Material Fragment
5★ EX Weapon Book of Ruin's Mysteries
 Fragment of Ruin's Mysteries
BT Weapon Book of Ruin's Miracles
 Fragment of Ruin's Miracles
Second 5★ Armor Book of Refuge's Mysteries
 Fragment of Refuge's Mysteries
7★ Armor Book of Refuge's Miracles
 Fragment of Refuge's Miracles
*A book can be refined from twenty fragments.

Realized gear will be displayed as a weapon or armor, and then may be further enhanced.


Unique materials are also required to perform limit breaks on weapons and armor.

The materials necessary will differ depending on the gear.
Limit break materials can be obtained by refining nuggets.

Gear Type Limit Break Material (After Realization) Nugget
5★ EX Weapon Ruin's Adamantine Ingot
 Ruin's Adamantine Nugget
BT Weapon Ruin's Ultima Ingot
 Ruin's Ultima Nugget
Second 5★ Armor Refuge's Adamantine Ingot
 Refuge's Adamantine Nugget
7★ Armor Refuge's Ultima Ingot
 Refuge's Ultima Nugget
*An ingot can be refined from twenty nuggets.

When realizing gear, you will receive as a bonus material that may be used to perform one limit break on that gear.

Obtaining Bonus Spheres

By performing three limit breaks on a 5★ weapon and raising its level to maximum, you can receive a bonus sphere.

Unlocking Sphere Slots

Characters have two sphere slots that may be used to activate spheres of the corresponding letter.
Enhancing realized 5★ armor to maximum will unlock a third sphere slot.

Selling Weapons and Armor, or Using as Enhancement Materials

Refining materials may be obtained by selling realized gear.
Materials that can be obtained are as follows:
Gear Type Material from Sale
5★ EX Weapon Ruin's Adamantine Nugget
Second 5★ Armor Refuge's Adamantine Nugget
7★ Armor Refuge's Ultima Nugget
*Above materials are obtained from selling gear after realization.
*Realized BT weapons cannot be sold.

The amount of materials obtained increased with the number of limit breaks performed.
Limit Breaks Materials
0 5
1 10
2 15
3 20
　
Realized gear cannot be used as enhancement materials for other gear.

*Realized gear is displayed as a weapon or armor and moved to its own inventory category. They do not take up space in the inventory category for unrealized gear.
